name: OneDrive
author: Bastiaan Kortenbout
description: Live OneDrive sync status and per-file progress for the OneDrive Client for Linux (abraunegg) in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Sync state, whole-run and per-file progress, recent files, pause/resume, login autostart and a settings view for the onedrive user service.

schema.label: Percentage next to the bar icon
schema.description: The run or file percentage beside the cloud while syncing.

schema.label: Progress line under the bar icon
schema.description: A thin line that fills with the run while a long run is on.

schema.label: Whole-run progress bar in the panel
schema.description: Files done and time left for a run longer than the threshold.

schema.label: Show the run bar from (seconds)
schema.description: A run is one burst of announced uploads and downloads. Below this projected duration only the current file is shown.

schema.label: Current file card
schema.description: The file being transferred with its own progress bar.

schema.label: Sync details
schema.description: Last sync, last cycle, tally, interval and folder.

schema.label: Storage usage
schema.description: Used and total space, asked from Microsoft.

schema.label: Action buttons
schema.description: Folder, restart, check and storage buttons.

schema.label: Notify on failures
schema.description: A desktop notification when a sync cycle fails or the client logs an error.

schema.label: Storage quota refresh (minutes)
schema.description: How often the panel may ask Microsoft for the storage quota when opened.

schema.label: Check for client updates
schema.description: Asks aur.archlinux.org and api.github.com for the newest onedrive-abraunegg every few hours. Nothing is installed without you.
